notes: CHK-003 has no disable iff (must hold during reset); its hits count the antecedent regardless of reset. CHK-004 uses a registered previous-reset flag (chk004_prev_rst_ok) so the check applies only when reset was high at both edges N-1 and N. The flag has no initial value, so it is X until the first clock edge. It is only used inside assertions that are disabled while reset is low.
